text:
incident-bot: PAGER — sev2: embedder cache eviction spike impacting /v1/embeddings in us-west-2. Error rate 12% > threshold. Pager routed to @sanjay-oncall.

sanjay-oncall: Taking pager. Starting live triage. Seeing 500s and elevated latency for embedding calls, backlog in worker queue.

oliver-sre: Looking now — logs show repeated kvcache eviction loop on embedder pod after a rolling deploy (embedder:1.4.0-rc). Heap churn + eviction thrash.

kevin-eng: I kicked off the canary earlier tonight. If that's correlated I can roll back canary to stable immediately. Command I'll run: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/embedder -n prod --to-revision=2`

maria-ops: Noted impact — three high-volume customers show elevated error rates. Ops will open seats with their account reps; pinging @liz-product for SLA comms.

sanjay-oncall: Mitigation plan: 1) rollback canary (kevin) 2) add temporary scale up of embedder pool (+30%) 3) apply soft rate-limiting on embeddings route to shed noisy traffic. Applying rate-limit: `routes.embeddings.rate_limit=150rps` now.

oliver-sre: Rolled rollback + scaled nodes. After rollback: error rate fell to ~1.2%, p95 latency back within SLO. Keeping mitigation controls for 30m to validate stability.

kevin-eng: Post-live action items (rough sizing in story points):
- INF-4523: root cause fix for eviction loop (kevin-eng) — 3d
- INF-4524: add rolling-update canary guard + health-check gating (oliver-sre) — 2d
- INF-4525: auto-detect backpressure + auto-fallback to lightweight embedder (platform) — 5d
- INF-4526: customer comms + SLA readout (maria-ops / liz-product) — 1d

maria-ops: Created JIRA tickets and added to remediation backlog: INF-4523, INF-4524, INF-4525, INF-4526. Tagging each with: Severity=High, Quarter=Q3, Owner as listed.

liz-product: For INF-4526 I'll draft a 1-paragraph summary + ETA for affected customers. Need expected rollout windows for INF-4523/4524 to include in comms.

sanjay-oncall: Proposed postmortem: tomorrow 11:00 PT, 30m. Agenda: timeline, root cause, action items + owners, rollout ETA, QA gating. @oliver-sre @kevin-eng please confirm availability.

oliver-sre: Confirmed. I'll assemble logs, timeline, and the canary diff for the PM.

kevin-eng: Confirmed. I'll attach deploy diffs and canary telemetry.

maria-ops: I'll send calendar invite and create the incident doc in Confluence (link will go in the invite). Also flagging INF-4525 as a candidate for dedicated remediation sprint — estimate 3 points but needs cross-team allocation.

sanjay-oncall: Notes for prioritization: Severity=High so triage into next remediation sprint unless Q3 roadmap capacity blocks it. If needed, move lower-priority perf work out to make room.

liz-product: I'll surface to GTM leads and product ops; request to reserve 2 engineer-days from platform for quick turnaround.

oliver-sre: After-action note: add a pre-deploy test that simulates kvcache pressure for canaries. That should be part of INF-4524.

sanjay-oncall: Closing live mitigation. Leaving remediation to owners. Incident marked as mitigated — follow-up postmortem scheduled and JIRA tasks created. Will update thread after postmortem.

maria-ops: +1 — publishing incident summary and next steps in the doc now.

kevin-eng: Thanks team.

(automated): Reaction added :white_check_mark: by sanjay-oncall
